test.create(box)
test.create(box::/mid)
test.create(box::/mid::/leaf)
test.destroy(box::/mid::/leaf)
test.destroy(box::/mid)
test.destroy(box)
test.create(source)
test.create(source::/mid)
test.create(source::/mid::/leaf)
test.move(source, box)
test.destroy(box::/mid::/leaf)
test.destroy(box::/mid)
test.destroy(box)
